title: Matthew 1:1
author: theophylact
work: Explanation of the Holy Gospel According to Matthew

footnotes.1: Greek ὅρασις ἣν εἶδεν Ἡσαΐας — the opening formula of the prophet Isaiah (cf. Isaiah 1:1).
footnotes.2: Greek ὁ λόγος ὁ γενόμενος πρὸς Ἰσαΐαν ("the word that came to Isaiah"). The "word that came to…" formula normally names Jeremiah or Hosea, not Isaiah; this second "Isaiah" is likely a textual or scribal slip.
footnotes.3: Theophylact's fixed antithesis νοητῶς ("intellectually, with the mind") vs. αἰσθητῶς ("perceptibly, by the senses"): the prophets saw only in the mind, whereas Matthew was with Christ bodily.
